continuity_scope: Terms-only audit bound to Pelgrane Press’s current 13th Age Second Edition Slipcase (SKU PEL13A201-P), comprising the 350-page Heroes’ Handbook and 250-page Gamemaster’s Guide, 592 pages total. Pelgrane confirmed Second Edition was available in retail and its webstore by May 8, 2026. First Edition core rules, First Edition GM Screen, supplements, adventures, organized play, novels, games, community material, and home campaigns are separate products or tables and are not merged.

coverage_rule: No individual characters are included. The accessible official Second Edition core-product material describes character options, icon connections, the Dragon Empire, and game mechanics, but does not offer stable claim-level profiles for individual dramatic characters. Icons, including individually named Icons, remain setting roles/entities unless directly profiled as individual dramatic characters. Races/kin, classes, Icons, backgrounds, One Unique Thing, magic, items, places, and rules remain terms/context.
omissions: All named individuals, including the Archmage, Lich King, Prince of Shadows, and other Icons, because the selected public evidence describes their connection/rule role rather than providing a claim-level dramatic profile.
All First Edition core and GM Screen claims, and all campaign/adventure, sourcebook, bestiary, supplement, organized-play, novel, game, community, and home-campaign material.
All generated player characters, example play characters, monsters, magic-item personalities, and default-setting events without an adequate individual profile in the selected public witness.
All unverified cross-edition retcons, external setting connections, or claims about how a given table must treat the deliberately non-canonical Dragon Empire.
uncertainties: Pelgrane states most First Edition books are compatible with Second Edition, while the original core book and First Edition GM Screen are exceptions. Compatibility does not merge records, establish cross-edition identity, or resolve altered rules/setting interpretation in this audit.

The core product presents the Dragon Empire as deliberately non-canonical so individual campaigns can generate different stories. No fixed campaign chronology, definitive Icon biography, or universal event sequence is asserted.

The official 2E errata page says its March 7, 2026 corrections are kept current in PDFs and will be incorporated into a second printing. It is used as a rules-maintenance boundary, not a source for later named-character or supplement claims.
Published Second Edition availability is confirmed by May 8, 2026; this audit does not infer an earlier exact retail street date.
The game contains fantasy violence, monsters, cults, dark rulers, and conflict. Those are fictional adventure/rules contexts, not judgments about real people, social roles, or belief systems.
evidence_basis: Official Pelgrane Second Edition product material establishes the current two-book core, its Heroes’ Handbook/Gamemaster’s Guide structure, the deliberately non-canonical Dragon Empire, and selected rules terms including kin, classes, Icons, backgrounds, One Unique Thing, icon connections, and the escalation die. The official availability and errata posts establish the May 2026 product and March 2026 maintenance boundaries. The accessible witnesses have no claim-level dramatic character profiles, so this is a terms-only rules/setting audit.
